messages.subject: ADVICE
parts:
I am conducting a distance sampling survey to make a study of four large mammals in a region of about 5000sqkm using line transect sampling. I have estimated to systematically place 10 transect within the covered region to gather data on both perpendicular distances  and cluster sizes, with time of observation, observer group, month of observation, season (dry and rainy), session (morning and evening) as covariates to determine distributions of distances measured and perform other analysis as required of DISTANCE software then consider identified distributions as PRIOR information for a Bayesian analysis thereafter as part of my PhD work. I have a little difficulty in finding answers to some of the following questions

1) How do i import my data making room for Multiple observer ( More than two observer group)

2) Will the use of DISTANCE Software alone sufficient for a PhD thesis in distance sampling research?

3) Is it possible to perform Bayesian Analysis in Distance? If not how can i perform posterior analysis in DISTANCE software or carry out Bayesian analysis with the results from DISTANCE?

 

Thanks to all and hope to get a maximum cooperation.
